cohort: 480 women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) admitted between January 2022 and January 2025.
finding: A nomogram incorporating SBP, proteinuria, APTT, ET, FIB, 25(OH)D, and HGF demonstrated high discrimination and good calibration for predicting postpartum hemorrhage risk in women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
followup_time: 24 hours after birth for PPH assessment
